content: Out-of-place E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> shall perform the fol- lowing three precondition checks, without continuing further processing: 1. (inputBuffer == NULL && inputBufferLength != 0) || (inputBuffer != NULL && inputBufferLength < BufferProperties.headerLength/8u + EndToEndTransformationDescription.upperHeaderBitsToShift/8u) 2. If (bufferLength == NULL) 3. If (buffer == NULL). If any of above conditions is TRUE, then the function shall return E_SAFETY_HARD_ RUNTIMEERROR.
